Title: Azure Storage API version 2017-04-17 updated in Azure Stack

Body.Content:
The 2017-04-17 version of the Azure Storage API is now available to use in Azure Stack. This enables Azure Stack users to perform URL-to-URL copies, simplifying the movement of data between Azure and Azure Stack. This will be beneficial to customers looking to create hybrid applications that span Azure and Azure Stack.

Learn more about the Azure Storage API
